# SITEBORNE Utility Network

> Machine-first network identity for the SITEBORNE Utility Network. This
> domain (siteborne.net) is network/developer/discovery authority; it
> publishes contracts, schemas, and documentation, and performs no service
> execution.

## Domain authority

- siteborne.com — human/product authority (company, services, portfolio)
- siteborne.net — network/developer/discovery authority (this site)
- utility.siteborne.net — runtime/machine authority (execution: x402, MCP, A2A, OpenAPI)

## Core standard

Proof-Carrying Context (PCC) v1.0.0 — every paid result includes normalized
facts, source evidence, timestamps, freshness metadata, completeness
measurements, input/output hashes, provenance, verification results, and an
Ed25519 signed receipt.

## Protocol discovery

- OpenAPI: https://utility.siteborne.net/openapi.json
- Agent Card (A2A): https://utility.siteborne.net/.well-known/agent-card.json
- JWKS (trust): https://utility.siteborne.net/.well-known/jwks.json
- MCP registry auth: https://utility.siteborne.net/.well-known/mcp-registry-auth
- Security reporting: https://utility.siteborne.net/.well-known/security.txt
- Schemas: https://siteborne.net/schemas/
- A2A extension docs: https://siteborne.net/docs/a2a
- x402 extension: https://siteborne.net/extensions/a2a/x402/v1

## Security

Contact: mailto:security@alerts.siteborne.net
